Dekimpe2000.statement: Every polycyclic-by-finite group has a normal finite-index subgroup realized as a uniform lattice in a connected simply connected solvable Lie group,with its intersection with the nilradical equal to its Fitting subgroup.
Dekimpe2000.conditions: May change both to a finite-index normal subgroup and to a suitable ambient solvable Lie group;no assertion that every initial ambient model has the Fitting intersection property.
